princeton-wordnet-3.0.obligations: Preserve the copyright notice, license statements and disclaimer in all copies and modifications; do not use Princeton's name in advertising.
princeton-wordnet-3.0.notes: English senses and lexical relations; no Vietnamese translation, CEFR or audio.

elispeak-common-mistakes.obligations: Include the copyright and permission notice in substantial copies.
elispeak-common-mistakes.notes: Small synthetic English-only dataset. Vietnamese explanations still require review before publication.

kaikki-enwiktionary.obligations: Preserve attribution, identify the exact snapshot and comply with share-alike/GFDL obligations for reused fields.
kaikki-enwiktionary.notes: Useful for English glosses, POS and IPA. It does not reliably provide Vietnamese meanings or CEFR. Never assign a default CEFR.

tatoeba-text.license_name: CC BY 2.0 FR or per-sentence CC0
tatoeba-text.obligations: Retain sentence IDs, author attribution and licensing notice; verify per-record license where CC0 is claimed. Audio has a separate contributor-selected license.
tatoeba-text.notes: Text can be used with attribution. Audio with an empty or incompatible license must not be imported.

mozilla-common-voice.license_name: CC0 1.0 unless a dataset states otherwise
mozilla-common-voice.attribution: Common Voice contributors; cite the selected release datasheet.
mozilla-common-voice.obligations: Obtain through Mozilla Data Collective, accept release terms, do not mirror the dataset, and verify the license/datasheet of the exact release.
mozilla-common-voice.notes: Not needed for normal SpeakSeed playback, which uses Web Speech API. Do not bulk-download or redistribute clips.

openjam.license_name: MIT (repository states it includes the data)
openjam.attribution: Openjam contributors and the per-release upstream attribution file.
openjam.obligations: Pin a release, preserve MIT notice, inspect per-release attribution and retain flags for AI-generated translations.
openjam.notes: Current roadmap does not list Vietnamese. Translations are described as AI-generated with community review, so they cannot be treated as human-reviewed without record-level evidence.

words-cefr-dataset.license_name: MIT repository; upstream dataset obligations require separate verification
words-cefr-dataset.attribution: Repository author plus CEFR-J, Google Books Ngram, WordNet and word-list upstream sources.
words-cefr-dataset.obligations: Verify every upstream dataset and the exact fork/revision before any publication.
words-cefr-dataset.notes: The repository license alone does not prove that all aggregated data can be relicensed under MIT. CEFR levels are inferred and must not be treated as official.

quality-1.0.1.owner_name: NYU Machine Learning for Language group and dataset contributors
quality-1.0.1.license_name: CC BY 4.0 dataset; article license is record-specific
quality-1.0.1.attribution: Pang et al. (2022), QuALITY, plus each article's source, author and license metadata.
quality-1.0.1.obligations: Attribute the dataset and verify each article's record-level license before redistributing or adapting its passage.
quality-1.0.1.notes: Passages average about 5,000 tokens and target long-document QA, so direct content is generally above SpeakSeed A0-B2 scope.

skypedia-en-vi.owner_name: Skypedia, MinhQND and credited upstream contributors
skypedia-en-vi.attribution: Skypedia, MinhQND and all upstream projects listed in ATTRIBUTION.md.
skypedia-en-vi.obligations: Provide full attribution, mark changes, preserve CC BY-SA 4.0 for adapted database content, and retain upstream notices.
skypedia-en-vi.notes: Already used in the current 4,213-word release. Preserve existing records; require legal/provenance review before expanding because the database aggregates several upstream resources.

flores-200.obligations: Attribute, link the license, indicate changes and share adaptations under CC BY-SA 4.0.
flores-200.notes: Parallel evaluation sentences, not learner-graded CEFR content.
